selection_rule: Only exact manifest members; no recursive repository copy and no implicit inclusion through evidence references.

excluded_categories.reason: Credentials, private storage or personal working files.
Uncleared raw provider outputs, original text-bearing inventories, gold and reference data are excluded.

excluded_categories.explicit_exception: Only the designated AutoSchemaKG license text; no original code/data checkout.
excluded_categories.reason: Dataset and third-party rights are not inherited from source-code licensing.
History, environments, weights, caches, archives and temporary working files are unnecessary for this finite selection.
No LaTeX sources, signature assets or editable logos. Final PDF is added separately only after author approval.
Local preliminary D1 outputs and ongoing private C6 outputs are not released final results.
An unapproved draft is not an adopted amendment.

originals: Excluded originals remain unchanged in their existing archive; preparation never deletes them.
scope_limit: Technical pattern checks do not establish licensing or semantic privacy clearance. No full repository/history scan is claimed.
